```{r}
df <- data.frame(matrix(ncol=2,nrow=1000))
colnames(df) <- c("T", "F")

for (i in 1:1000) {

X <- rnorm(1000)
Y <- rnorm(1000)

lm1 <- lm(Y~X)

T <- summary(lm1)$coefficients[2,3]
F <- linearHypothesis(lm1,"X=0")$F[2]

df[i,1] <- T
df[i,2] <- F
}
